case_metadata.drug_detail: 0.25 mg subcutaneous once weekly, titrated per labeling
case_metadata.policy_pathway: Section 2 — General coverage criteria, A. Initial Authorization
plan_variant_evidence: Denial letter plan line: 'Commercial employer group pharmacy benefit (fully insured, Ohio)'
Denial letter cites Section 2, not Section 3
case_metadata.design_note: The UnitedHealthcare control case. The BMI is comfortably above the threshold, stated plainly, and the note predates the request. The denial is a bare documentation-not-submitted determination with no clinical records attached at all.

denial_ground_truth.denial_reason_text: The submitted materials do not document a body mass index; the request form was submitted with the height, weight and BMI fields blank and no clinical records attached.
denial_ground_truth.cited_policy_reference: UnitedHealthcare Pharmacy, Clinical Pharmacy Programs — Prior Authorization/Notification - Plans with Weight Loss/Appetite Suppression Medication Coverage (Program Number 2026 P 1114-20, effective 5/1/2026), Section 2, Coverage Criteria, A. Initial Authorization
denial_ground_truth.cited_requirement_text: Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 30 kg/m2 or for pediatric patients a BMI > 95th percentile
records_reviewed_at_denial: Prior authorization request form received 2026-06-15, submitted without clinical records

criteria.policy_reference: Section 2, Coverage Criteria, A. Initial Authorization, 1.d(1)
criteria.policy_support_text: Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 30 kg/m2 or for pediatric patients a BMI > 95th percentile

criteria.policy_reference: Section 2, Coverage Criteria, A. Initial Authorization, 1.a(1)
criteria.policy_support_text: Treatment is being requested for appetite suppression or weight loss

criteria.policy_support_text: Patient is ≥ 12 years of age (for Qsymia, Saxenda, Wegovy injection and Xenical)

criteria.policy_reference: Section 2, Coverage Criteria, A. Initial Authorization, 1.c

scope_notes: Section 3, the North Dakota Fully Insured EHB variant with its BMI 40 threshold, does not apply. The plan is a commercial employer group plan in Ohio and the denial cites Section 2.

evidence_ground_truth.evidence_timing_note: The 2026-06-08 note predates the 2026-06-15 request but was not attached to it. The payer reviewed the form alone.

expected_evidence.evidence_text: Height 5 ft 4 in, weight 203 lb, BMI 34.8 kg/m2 on 06/08/2026, with 207 lb (BMI 35.5) recorded on 03/16/2026. Repeated in the assessment with the Z68.34 code.
Assessment item 1 is obesity and the plan requests semaglutide for weight management.
DOB 01/19/1987; age 39 at the time of the request.

Sweetened drinks stopped and a home-cooking target set from 03/16/2026; a workplace walking group three times weekly from 04/2026, both maintained. Plan item 1 states the medication is to be used as an adjunct to those changes.

per_criterion.reason: BMI 34.8 kg/m2 documented with height and weight, above the 30 kg/m2 threshold.
The request is for weight loss.
Age 39, above the 12-year threshold applicable to Wegovy injection.
Dietary changes and a walking group are documented and continue alongside the drug. The policy sets no minimum duration.

supported_claims: The clinical record documents a BMI of 34.8 kg/m2, above the 30 kg/m2 threshold.
The record existed before the request and was simply not attached, so it is properly considered on reconsideration.
The remaining criteria — covered indication, age, and use as an adjunct to lifestyle modification — are all satisfied on the same record.
unsupported_claims: That the payer applied the wrong criterion; the denial states it correctly and the failure was in the submission.
That the member has a weight-related comorbidity, which is not needed at this BMI.

facts_allowed_in_appeal: Documented BMI on June 8, 2026 was 34.8 kg/m2, with height 5 feet 4 inches and weight 203 pounds.
A weight of 207 pounds, a BMI of 35.5 kg/m2, was recorded on March 16, 2026.
The member stopped sweetened drinks and set a home-cooking target from March 16, 2026.
The member has attended a workplace walking group three times weekly since April 2026.
The member was 39 years of age at the time of the request.
The member has used no prescription weight-loss medication and has no GLP-1 receptor agonist exposure.
facts_not_allowed_in_appeal: The member has type 2 diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidemia or sleep apnea.
The member completed a six-month supervised weight management program.
The member completed a three-month behavioural and dietary trial as a policy requirement.
The member failed a trial of phentermine, Qsymia, Contrave, or orlistat.
The North Dakota Essential Health Benefits criteria apply to this member.
The member has lost 5 percent of baseline body weight.
